Data Scientist - Migration Intelligence
Datafold, Inc. - Brooklyn, NY
May telecommute from the continental U.S.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Evaluate third-party tools, platforms, and emerging technologies relevant to data migration, data infrastructure, and AI-assisted workflows, including technical benchmarking and integration feasibility analysis, and build-versus-buy assessment.

 - Act as an internal subject matter resource for data pipeline evaluation and migration methodologies, validating analytical workflows on internal data and translating operational findings into structured product feedback.
